description: This file defines a class 'TestCoverageCreator' that automates the process of generating and validating test cases for a FastAPI application by analyzing call graphs, coverage data, and external interactions, utilizing GPT-based code generation and Docker execution.

classes.name: TestCoverageCreator
classes.description: A class responsible for orchestrating the process of generating, validating, and submitting test cases for a FastAPI application based on call graph analysis, coverage data, and GPT-generated code.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TestCoverageCreator with Redis client and repository URL, setting up helpers and directories.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to build call graphs from Redis, analyze them, and process endpoints for test generation.

methods.name: process_endpoint
methods.description: Handles the process of generating tests for a specific endpoint, including coverage calculation, interaction analysis, GPT prompt creation, and PR submission.

methods.name: build_graphs_from_redis
methods.description: Retrieves call graph data from Redis and constructs CallGraph objects.

methods.name: generate_and_test_pytest_code
methods.description: Uses GPT to generate pytest code, executes it in Docker, and compares coverage before and after.

methods.name: determine_invoked_endpoint
methods.description: Identifies which API endpoint was invoked based on the call graph nodes.

methods.name: calculate_endpoint_coverage
methods.description: Calculates coverage percentage for each endpoint based on test output.

methods.name: calculate_uncovered_lines
methods.description: Counts the number of lines not covered for a given endpoint.

methods.name: select_function_to_cover
methods.description: Selects the least covered function node in the graph for further testing.

methods.name: compare_test_coverage
methods.description: Compares initial and modified test coverage data, logging the differences.

methods.name: analyze_external_interactions_with_chatgpt
methods.description: Analyzes code to identify external interactions like DB queries or API calls, using GPT.

methods.name: parse_interaction_response
methods.description: Parses GPT response to extract interaction details.

methods.name: analyze_graph_for_interactions_and_context
methods.description: Recursively analyzes call graph nodes for external interactions and compressed nodes.

methods.name: generate_import_statement
methods.description: Creates an import statement for the app module based on paths.

methods.name: serialize_interactions
methods.description: Serializes interaction details into JSON files for mocking.

methods.name: generate_test_prompt
methods.description: Creates a detailed GPT prompt for generating pytest code based on endpoint and interaction data.
